review_reference: The services as deployed now, after backend releases backend-41369624838-1-e9666a23262ea216 (D-Eminence/hid-system#145 at a42b48a: identity-api and notification-api) and backend-41371342099-1-69bbfeff0bebc8f6 (D-Eminence/hid-system#146 at 6f900b6: ehr-api, lab-api and pharmacy-api). gateway, ocr-api, outreach-api and support-api are unchanged since 6c6fc18. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins (6c6fc18): identity-api accepts the staff-reset, provider-enrollment and staff-invitation security checks on the five product sites (ehr., lab., pharmacy., migrate., outreach.) as well as app., and notification-api's staff emails link to the staff member's product site; lab-api and pharmacy-api work lists answer open work first, then done work, with the same shape (a reversed dispensing counts as done); ehr-api's chat sources may carry origin and originLabel, which this frontend reads as optional. Nothing else this frontend calls changed shape. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-11-01 ("approve re-pin", for the backend release that lets staff pages run on each product site) and on 2026-11-02 ("all recommended", which included re-pinning after the step 1 backend release).
